description: This Python script defines a class 'TestCoverageCreator' that automates the process of generating and validating test cases for a FastAPI application by analyzing call graphs, coverage data, and external interactions, and then creating pull requests with the generated tests.

classes.name: TestCoverageCreator
classes.description: A class responsible for analyzing call graphs, coverage, and external interactions to generate pytest code for testing FastAPI endpoints, and managing pull requests with the generated tests.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the TestCoverageCreator with Redis client and repository URL, sets up helpers and directories.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to build graphs from Redis, analyze them, and process endpoints for test generation.

methods.name: process_endpoint
methods.description: Generates test code for a specific endpoint, executes tests, and creates pull requests with new tests.

methods.name: build_graphs_from_redis
methods.description: Retrieves call graphs stored in Redis matching the repository URL.

methods.name: generate_and_test_pytest_code
methods.description: Uses GPT to generate pytest code from a prompt, executes tests, and compares coverage.

methods.name: determine_invoked_endpoint
methods.description: Identifies which API endpoint was invoked based on the call graph.

methods.name: calculate_endpoint_coverage
methods.description: Calculates coverage percentage for each endpoint based on test output.

methods.name: calculate_uncovered_lines
methods.description: Counts the number of uncovered lines for an endpoint.

methods.name: select_function_to_cover
methods.description: Selects the least covered function in the call graph for testing.

methods.name: compare_test_coverage
methods.description: Compares initial and modified test coverage to identify improvements.

methods.name: analyze_external_interactions_with_chatgpt
methods.description: Analyzes code to identify external interactions like DB or API calls using GPT.

methods.name: parse_interaction_response
methods.description: Parses GPT response to extract interaction details.

methods.name: analyze_graph_for_interactions_and_context
methods.description: Recursively analyzes call graph nodes for external interactions and compressed nodes.

methods.name: generate_import_statement
methods.description: Creates an import statement for the app module based on paths.

methods.name: serialize_interactions
methods.description: Serializes interaction details into JSON files for mocking.

methods.name: generate_test_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt for GPT to generate pytest code based on endpoint details and interactions.
